description: This file defines utility functions for error handling in an Express.js application, including throwing errors, handling validation errors, and passing errors to next middleware.

methods.name: throwError
methods.description: Throws an error with a specified message and status code.

methods.name: handleValidationErrors
methods.description: Handles validation errors from express-validator, throwing an error if validation fails.

methods.name: passError
methods.description: Passes an error to the next middleware, setting a default status code if not present.
